general.name: wonderwhy-er/DesktopCommanderMCP
general.description: This is MCP server for Claude that gives it terminal control, file system search and diff file editing capabilities

general.name: oven-sh/bun
general.description: Incredibly fast JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager – all in one
general.description_zh: 极速 JavaScript 运行时、打包器、测试运行器和包管理器——一体化解决方案
features: 快速的 JavaScript runtime，可作为 Node.js 的 drop-in 替代
内置 Node.js 兼容的 package manager，安装速度显著更快
内置 test runner 和 script runner，无需额外工具
原生支持 TypeScript 和 JSX，开箱即用
基于 Zig 编写，由 JavaScriptCore 驱动，启动快、内存占用低

general.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
general.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
general.description_zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的生产级工程技能。
features: 8 个 slash 命令映射开发生命周期，自动激活对应 skills
为 AI coding agent 封装资深工程师的工作流与质量门禁
`/build auto` 一次批准后自主完成计划生成与全部任务实现
skills 按任务自动触发，如 API 设计、frontend UI 工程
支持通过 Claude Code marketplace 一键安装

general.name: jbeder/yaml-cpp
general.description: A YAML parser and emitter in C++

general.name: mattpocock/skills
general.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .claude directory.
general.description_zh: 真正工程师的 Skills。直接来自我的 .claude 目录。
features: 提供小巧、可组合、易于适配的 agent skills，适用于任意 model
通过 skills.sh 一行命令安装并配置 skills
支持 GitHub、Linear 或本地文件作为 issue tracker
提供 grilling session 让 agent 主动追问需求以消除误解
适配 Claude Code、Codex 等多种 coding agent

general.name: obra/superpowers
general.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
general.description_zh: 一套行之有效的 agentic skills 框架与软件开发方法论。
features: 为 coding agent 提供完整的软件开发方法论与可组合 skills
先理清需求规格，分块确认后再生成实现计划
实现计划强调红绿 TDD、YAGNI 与 DRY 原则
通过 subagent-driven-development 让 agent 自主完成各项任务
支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI 等多种 harness

general.name: microsoft/TypeScript
general.description: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that compiles to clean JavaScript output.

general.name: catchorg/Catch2
general.description: A modern, C++-native, test framework for unit-tests, TDD and BDD - using C++14, C++17 and later (C++11 support is in v2.x branch, and C++03 on the Catch1.x branch)

general.name: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
general.description: TencentDB Agent Memory delivers fully local long-term memory for AI Agents via a 4-tier progressive pipeline, with zero external API dependencies.

general.name: davila7/claude-code-templates
general.description: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code

general.name: zeux/meshoptimizer
general.description: Mesh optimization library that makes meshes smaller and faster to render

general.name: tailscale/tailscale
general.description: The easiest, most secure way to use WireGuard and 2FA.

general.name: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
general.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

general.name: iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI
general.description: OfficeCLI is the first and best Office suite purpose-built for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files. Free, open-source, single binary, no Office installation required.

general.name: hashicorp/terraform
general.description: Terraform enables you to safely and predictably create, change, and improve infrastructure. It is a source-available tool that codifies APIs into declarative configuration files that can be shared amongst team members, treated as code, edited, reviewed, and versioned.

general.name: grpc/grpc
general.description: C++ based gRPC (C++, Python, Ruby, Objective-C, PHP, C#)

general.name: vercel/next.js

集成 Rust-based JavaScript 工具链，提供极速构建
扩展最新 React 特性，支持服务端与客户端渲染
